title: Verification failure details
responsibility: Presents verification failure causes while keeping the original failure list accessible.

inputs.name: HarnessFailures.record
inputs.description: Required caller-provided record label used in accessible names for the original failure list.

inputs.name: HarnessFailures.failures
inputs.description: Required original failure messages. The grouping helper determines whether to present plain failures or grouped subjects and causes.

inputs.name: HarnessFailures.problems
inputs.description: Optional additional record problems, defaulting to an empty list. These remain visible separately from grouped failures.

outputs.name: HarnessFailures
outputs.description: Plain or grouped failure explanations, counts and an expandable complete original list in a focusable scrolling region, followed by any record problems.
